description: Header file defining tunable GEMM (General Matrix Multiply) operations for CUDA, including classes for different GEMM variants, type handling, and environment-based registration of optimized kernels.

classes.name: DefaultGemmOp
classes.description: Implements a default GEMM operation using cuBLAS.

classes.name: DefaultGemmAndBiasOp
classes.description: Implements a GEMM operation with bias addition.

classes.name: GemmTunableOp
classes.description: Template class for tunable GEMM operations with different data types and layouts.

classes.name: GemmAndBiasTunableOp
classes.description: Template class for tunable GEMM with bias addition.

classes.name: GemmStridedBatchedTunableOp
classes.description: Template class for tunable batched GEMM with stride.

classes.name: ScaledGemmTunableOp
classes.description: Template class for tunable scaled GEMM operations.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Executes the GEMM operation with given parameters.

methods.name: Signature
methods.description: Returns a string signature for the tunable GEMM operation.

methods.name: _transposeBoolFromChar
methods.description: Converts a character to a boolean indicating transpose.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if a value is zero, specialized for different types.

methods.name: TypeName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type name.
